question: Among cobalt-free lithium-ion cathodes, what practical capacity and operating voltage does LiFePO4 deliver?
rendered:
Document title: "Lithium Iron Aluminum Nickelate, LiNixFeyAlzO2—New Sustainable Cathodes for Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Li-Ion Batteries" is more relevant to the question.

In this document, on page 9, it is stated that "The most famous olivine cathode is the LiFePO4 (LFP), which was first reported in 1997 by Padhi et al.^[28] LFP delivers a practical capacity of 170 mAh g^− 1 through the Fe^2 +/Fe^3 + redox couple at an operating voltage of 3.4V versus Li/Li^+ (see Figure 3b)."
